chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Qurashī, from Ismāʿīl ibn Bashshār, from Aḥmad ibn Ḥabīb, from al-Ḥakam al-Khayyāṭ, from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd al-Azdī.

key_terms.الْأَزْدِيِّ: Al-Azdī; a tribal attribution identifying ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd.
key_terms.الْخَيَّاطِ: Al-Khayyāṭ; an identifying epithet meaning the tailor.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an explicit statement of narration by the compiler.
key_terms.عَمِّهِ: His uncle; indicates a familial link within the transmission chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd al-Azdī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is not a doctrinal or legal hadith text, but a clarification of the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd al-Azdī. Its significance lies in hadith documentation, preserving the line of transmission for material included in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
